headline: Attackers weaponized freshly disclosed ServiceNow and WordPress flaws within days while espionage crews hid command channels inside Microsoft 365 calendars.

emerging_trends.text: Attackers are turning newly disclosed flaws into live exploitation within days, hitting the ServiceNow AI Platform and WordPress core almost before defenders can patch.
AI infrastructure now sits on both ends of the attack, as EncForge ransomware encrypts model weights and thousands of FakeGit repositories masquerade as AI skills to spread malware.

Espionage operators increasingly route command-and-control through trusted cloud services, planting tasking inside Outlook calendar events and Microsoft Graph traffic to blend with normal business activity.

topics.title: WordPress wp2shell Mass Exploitation
topics.latest_developments: A public exploit landed and drove mass internet scanning, with successful chaining of CVE-2026-60137 and CVE-2026-63030 already well underway, and SANS confirmed the SQL-injection-to-RCE bug in WordPress core now carries CVE-2026-63030.
topics.summary: wp2shell chains two flaws in WordPress core to give unauthenticated remote code execution and full site takeover across one of the largest attack surfaces online. Sites must run WordPress 6.9.5 or 7.0.2.

sources.title: WordPress wp2shell Exploitation Grows as Public Exploit Fuels Mass Scanning
'WP2Shell' Opens Millions of WordPress Sites to Remote Takeover
WordPress Exploitation Underway (CVE-2026-63030)

topics.title: CAV3RN Espionage Abuses Outlook Calendars
topics.latest_developments: Kaspersky's GReAT team detailed a new Project CAV3RN module that hides command-and-control inside Outlook calendar events through the Microsoft Graph API and recovers its configuration from DNS AAAA records, extending the calendar-hijacking framework that Group-IB tracks as HollowGraph and ties to Iranian espionage.
topics.summary: The modular Cavern/CAV3RN backdoor plants operator tasking and exfiltrates stolen files as attachments on Microsoft 365 calendar events, some dated to 2050, so its traffic blends into legitimate Graph API calls. Defenders should watch for anomalous Graph calendar activity.

sources.title: New Project CAV3RN module abuses Outlook calendar events for C2 and DNS AAAA records for configuration recovery
HollowGraph Malware Hides C2 and Stolen Files in Microsoft 365 Events Dated 2050
New HollowGraph malware uses Microsoft Graph for stealthy C2 comms

topics.title: Fresh Breaches Hit Insurers and Governments
topics.latest_developments: Clover Health Investments disclosed that attackers used social engineering to hijack employee accounts holding personal and health data, hackers spent nine months inside South Korea's diplomatic-academy training system stealing Foreign Ministry staff records, and Romania's land registry called a cyberattack the worst incident in its history as it raced to restore property transactions.
topics.summary: Three unrelated intrusions exposed sensitive records at Medicare insurer Clover Health, South Korea's Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and Romania's national land registry, with social engineering and prolonged unnoticed access driving each. Affected people and agencies face notification and recovery.

sources.title: Clover Health Investments Discloses Data Breach
Hackers were inside South Korea's diplomat training system for 9 months
Romania races to restore land registry after cyberattack disrupts property market

topics.title: ServiceNow AI Platform RCE Exploited
topics.latest_developments: Defused Cyber caught in-the-wild exploitation of CVE-2026-6875 within days of disclosure, a 9.5-rated sandbox escape in the ServiceNow AI Platform that lets an unauthenticated attacker run arbitrary code, and ServiceNow has shipped patches.
topics.summary: The flaw sits in the ServiceNow AI Platform and hands remote code execution to anyone who can reach the instance, with no login required. Administrators should apply ServiceNow's fix immediately.

sources.title: Critical ServiceNow AI Platform Flaw Exploited for Unauthenticated Code Execution
Exploitation of ServiceNow Vulnerability Seen Days After Disclosure

topics.title: JadePuffer Deploys EncForge AI Ransomware
topics.latest_developments: Sysdig tied a second intrusion on the same Langflow server to the autonomous AI-agent operator JadePuffer, which now drops ENCFORGE, a compiled Go ransomware built to encrypt model weights, vector indexes, and training datasets across the host.
topics.summary: JadePuffer breaks in through a Langflow remote-code-execution flaw and, with EncForge, targets AI infrastructure files—model weights, vector indexes, and training datasets—for encryption across the filesystem. Operators running Langflow should patch and isolate model storage.

sources.title: New ENCFORGE Ransomware Targets AI Model Files in Langflow RCE Attack
JadePuffer agentic attacks now target AI model data with ransomware

topics.title: FakeGit Floods GitHub With SmartLoader
topics.latest_developments: Researchers uncovered nearly 7,600 malicious GitHub repositories in the FakeGit campaign, more than 800 of them posing as AI skills or Model Context Protocol servers, all delivering the SmartLoader malware through convincing README files and booby-trapped ZIP archives.
topics.summary: FakeGit clones real projects and lookalike developer profiles to trick users into downloading SmartLoader, which stages follow-on infostealers. Developers should verify repository provenance before running any downloaded code.

sources.title: FakeGit Campaign Uses 7,600 GitHub Repositories to Spread SmartLoader Malware
